targetTexts.1: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
targetTexts.2: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
targetTexts.3: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
targetTexts.4: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.
targetTexts.5: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
targetTexts.6: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
targetTexts.7: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
targetTexts.8: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
targetTexts.9: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
targetTexts.10: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
targetTexts.11: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.
targetTexts.12: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
targetTexts.13: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
